inlines.v: RO'SY, adjective [from rose.] 1. Resembling a rose in color or qualities; blooming; red; blushing; charming. While blooming youth and gay delight sit on thy rosy check contest. The rosy morn resigns her light. 2. Made in the form of a rose.
